maria (FinOps): heads up — I pulled the AWS marketplace monthly statement and our ledger shows a $11,764 shortfall for Jan.
kevin (Infra): shortfall vs invoice or vs expected commission?
mare (typo) maria (FinOps): vs expected commission after waterfall. invoice total matches, but the reseller commission line doesn't add up.
sam (BillingOps): on it, uploading the marketplace CSV to the shared bucket: gs://redwood-billing/marketplace/aws/jan_statement.csv :link:
finance-bot: file uploaded by sam to gs://redwood-billing/marketplace/aws/jan_statement.csv (checksum: abc123)
raj (CloudEng): any chance this is related to reserved capacity refunds or committed usage adjustments? those sometimes show up as negative line items.
maria (FinOps): good question — the statement has a block labelled "Adjustments / Credits" but our waterfall calc ignored the timing window for credits.
kevin (Infra): quick note: Dedicated reservations had a prorated cancellation for customer C-42 on 2026-01-11, that generated a marketplace credit.
sam (BillingOps): here's the relevant slice from the CSV: ```
account_id,product,amount,type,date
acct-C42,ReservedInstanceRefund,-3742.00,credit,2026-01-11
acct-PLG14,MarketplaceCommission,14230.00,charge,2026-01-31
acct-RSLR1,ResellerFee,-1500.00,commission,2026-01-31
```
raj (CloudEng): that refund would flow through AWS waterfall before reseller cut. If our ETL applied reseller cut against gross charge without subtracting refunds, math will be off.
maria (FinOps): exactly — our ledger code assumes commission is X% of gross ARR per invoice, not net-of-adjustments.
kevin (Infra): can BillingOps re-run the Jan ingest with "apply_adjustments_first=true" and post a delta?
sam (BillingOps): starting a reingest now, will tag the job and post logs. job id: bill-reingest-20260131-09
finance-bot: reingest job bill-reingest-20260131-09 queued by sam — view: https://console.redwood.internal/jobs/bill-reingest-20260131-09
maria (FinOps): pinging for priority — this impacts month-end revenue recognition for marketplace channel. :exclamation:
kevin (Infra): quick ask — does the reingest require any Infra changes? should be purely ETL, right @raj?
raj (CloudEng): ETL only, but recommend running on a node that's isolated from peak inference jobs. I'll reserve one small worker node in us-west2 for 30m.
sam (BillingOps): reingest completed. preliminary delta: commission adjusted +$11,764 so ledger now matches statement. uploading reconciled CSV to the bucket.
maria (FinOps): awesome — can you paste the exact steps you changed so we can patch the monthly pipeline?
sam (BillingOps): changed order: 1) apply negative adjustments/credits 2) compute net-for-commission 3) apply reseller percentages. single-line config flip: `commission_calc.net_of_adjustments = true`
kevin (Infra): can we add a unit test that covers refund-then-commission flow? this bit caused us outage before in accounting exports.
raj (CloudEng): will add a small integration test in billing-etl repo. I will also schedule the reserved worker for the reingest to avoid noisy neighbors.
maria (FinOps): filing a quick Ops ticket so FinOps can sign off on the corrected numbers and we can update recognized revenue. ticket: FIN-BILL-2026-037
finance-bot: ticket FIN-BILL-2026-037 created by maria (link: https://issues.redwood/internal/FIN-BILL-2026-037)
maria (FinOps): thanks all. Learned: always net adjustments before applying commission waterfall. will add to the billing playbook. :memo:
